Explicit source subcircuits omit documented out-and-back nonboundary strokes; no buffer, make_valid, invented closing edge, smoothing, clipping or geographical snapping is used. The frozen earlier municipal-outline affine georegistration into EOV/EPSG:23700 is preserved and inverse-projected into WGS84. Historical source overlaps and small differences from the current OSM city boundary remain unmodified and recorded.
